blocks.text: Take longer showers and enjoy endless hot water with tankless water heater installation in Alamo Heights, TX. A tankless water heater is a solid upgrade from older models that use a storage tank to heat your water. These units heat water on-demand and don’t waste energy keeping the storage tank hot.

Whether you’re tired of running out of hot water or just want a more energy-efficient alternative to older model water heaters, tankless is a great option. At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, we handle tankless water heater repairs and installations to give you a more comfortable home.
What Are the Benefits of Tankless Water Heater Installation?

A traditional water heater typically stores somewhere between 40 and 100 gallons of heated water. Once that supply is exhausted, it can take an hour or more for your hot water to be ready again. This creates backups for the shower, slows your dishwasher, and might delay your ability to wash clothes. Lack of hot water is a major inconvenience, even when it’s only temporary. But, with tankless water heater installation, it become a thing of the past.

A tankless water heater is space-saving and energy-saving. Because it only heats water when you need it, you aren’t spending money to keep water hot while it isn’t in use. No tank means you have a smaller footprint for your hot water, which is particularly important in apartments or smaller homes where every square foot is critical. Plus, there are lots of rebates and tax credits that may help offset the cost of a new unit, so talk to a licensed plumber from Rosenberg Plumbing & Air today to see if making the switch is an economical decision for your home.

items: Less space reserved for the water heater

blocks.text: Another big benefit to tankless water heaters is the reduced need for maintenance and repairs. No tank means no need to flush the tank annually. Tankless water heater repair services might only be on your to-do list as your unit reaches the end of its life.
